integrity.closedness_basis: The common-root locus is the proper image of the projective incidence correspondence.
integrity.covering_basis: A monomial system has no projective common zero exactly when its selected pure powers cover every coordinate variable.
integrity.first_public_date_basis: The arXiv record for math/0007036 lists first submission 2000-07-06.
integrity.fixed_point_basis: A rapidly separated diagonal cocharacter isolates all monomial coordinate points in every coefficient factor.
integrity.localization_basis: Compactly supported Euler characteristic localizes to the fixed locus for algebraic C* actions.

scientific_limitations: Only Euler characteristics are computed; no Betti, Hodge, motivic, degree, or singularity formula is claimed.
The theorem requires complete homogeneous linear series over the complex numbers and separate projectivization of each coefficient block.
An equivalent unindexed or folklore fixed-point count remains a residual originality risk.
title: Euler characteristic of homogeneous consistency loci
